_doc: Highwayman parking tiles per local map. tileNum = y*200+x (0-based, 200 tiles wide). carTile values below (where not -1) are extracted directly from the original compiled map_enter_p_proc bytecode (data/scripts/<map>.int) via a static disassembly pass — see wiki/car_system.md §8 for methodology and verification. -1 = no verified value; falls back to the entrance-offset heuristic. trunkTile is intentionally left -1 for every map: the original game computes the trunk's position at runtime via tile_num_in_dir() relative to the car body rather than a second hardcoded literal, which is what DH2's carTile+2 fallback already approximates (exact original direction/distance not extracted). Tune unresolved entries in-game: window.debugCarTile() prints the tile under the cursor.

denbus1._source: data/scripts/denbus1.int @0x18ea (first of 2 entrance-specific call sites; second is tile 24548 @0x2d3a, used when entering via the other door)

denbus2._source: no direct create_object_sid(CAR,...) literal found in denbus2.int — car likely never parks on this submap

broken2._source: no direct literal found in broken2.int

klamall._source: no direct literal found in klamall.int — kladwtwn.int is the actual car-parking submap for Klamath, not klamall

ncr1._source: no direct literal found in ncr1.int — ncrent.int is the actual car-parking submap for NCR, not ncr1/ncr2

ncr2._source: no direct literal found in ncr2.int

ncrent._source: data/scripts/ncrent.int @0xf50 — newly identified as the real NCR car-parking map; was missing from this table entirely

newr2._source: no direct literal found in newr2.int

vctyctyd._source: data/scripts/vctyctyd.int @0xedc — newly identified Vault City car-parking map; was missing from this table entirely
